input.command:
cd /tmp/attest-coldstart/final-1/buyer; export ATTEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:40549
curl -s $ATTEST_URL/pubkey; echo
python3 -c "import json;json.dump(json.load(open('../exchange/to-brightforge/reply-974f1d0c9dc0.json'))['receipt'],open('/tmp/claude-0/-tmp-attest-coldstart-final-1-buyer/15ea7858-ce01-47a1-94ea-841e906e414a/scratchpad/r.json','w'))" 2>/dev/null || { mkdir -p /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-attest-coldstart-final-1-buyer/15ea7858-ce01-47a1-94ea-841e906e414a/scratchpad; python3 -c "import json;json.dump(json.load(open('../exchange/to-brightforge/reply-974f1d0c9dc0.json'))['receipt'],open('/tmp/claude-0/-tmp-attest-coldstart-final-1-buyer/15ea7858-ce01-47a1-94ea-841e906e414a/scratchpad/r.json','w'))"; }
attest verify-receipt /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-attest-coldstart-final-1-buyer/15ea7858-ce01-47a1-94ea-841e906e414a/scratchpad/r.json; echo "exit $?"
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,hashlib,urllib.request
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PublicKey
r=json.load(open('/tmp/attest-coldstart/final-1/exchange/to-brightforge/reply-974f1d0c9dc0.json'))['receipt']
gate=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:40549/pubkey'))['gate']
c=lambda o: json.dumps(o,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False).encode()
body={k:v for k,v in r.items() if k not in('id','sig')}
print("gate match", r['gate']==gate)
print("id ok", hashlib.sha256(c(body)).hexdigest()==r['id'])
Ed25519PublicKey.from_public_bytes(bytes.fromhex(gate)).verify(bytes.fromhex(r['sig']), c({k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='sig'}))
print("sig ok")
EOF
curl -s "$ATTEST_URL/receipts?limit=50" | grep -o '04ace183[0-9a-f]*' | head -1
